responsibility: Specializes the Arm backend for GNU/Linux EABI targets. It defines the combined BPABI and GNU/Linux target builtins, chooses the default soft-float AAPCS-Linux ABI, sets endian-sensitive linker emulations, dynamic linker paths for glibc and musl including hard/soft-float variants, and Linux/Android-specific CC1, link, startfile, endfile, and library specs, making it the main configuration layer for modern Arm Linux EABI toolchains.
